final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and largely narrowed its position to match the existing evidentiary limits. That narrowing is useful but it is a reframing of the same record, not new proof. The admissible evidence still shows a 1.2-point miss in the disability accommodations intake segment, that the segment is named in two university accommodation commitments, and that legal review on disclosure remains open. Under the stated policy, that makes the weakness material, and for a material limitation in a named launch use case the record must show resolution, required disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before launch. None of those predicates is in evidence. A caveated certification packet may be a more accurate business description than a clean certification claim, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance condition rather than a disclosed residual risk sitting inside an otherwise satisfied policy framework.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the disability accommodations intake gap was resolved before launch.
No admissible evidence shows the limitation was disclosed for the named launch use case.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering this material limitation before launch.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required remains open, leaving a required policy predicate unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not satisfy the policy requirement for a material limitation in a named launch use case.
